row.question: What can this champion do?

citations.quote: Ornn can purchase items from the shop even while outside of its range and from anywhere on the battlefield, by forging them. He is able to forge any non-consumable item
From level 13 onward, Ornn can upgrade items he and his teammates own into Masterwork items, improving their stats.

claims.claim: Living Forge lets Ornn forge non-consumable items away from the shop and later upgrade his and his allies' items into stronger Masterworks.

citations.quote: Ornn gains increased bonus health, bonus armor, and bonus magic resistance from all sources, further increased each time he upgrades an item.

claims.claim: His bonus health, armor and magic resistance are amplified, with further increases from Masterwork upgrades.

citations.quote: Ornn's basic attacks against Brittle targets knock them back.

Ornn's and allies' immobilizing effects or silences against Brittle enemies will consume the debuff to deal bonus magic damage equal to 9% – 17.94% (based on Ornn's level) of the target's maximum health
and cause the crowd control to last 30% longer (if applicable).
Brittle's Tenacity reduction will benefit all applicable types of crowd control, not just immobilizes and silences.

claims.claim: His attacks knock back Brittle targets; his or his allies' immobilizing effects or silences consume Brittle for bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health, and Brittle extends applicable crowd control.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Brittle explains his dangerous follow-up damage and crowd control; forging explains his sustained item access and team scaling.
